english.title: Fail execute works to prevent soil / refuse being washed / falling / carried into street / sewer / gully
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been served with a notice under section 151(1) of the Highways Act 1980 requiring you to execute such works as would prevent soil or refuse from land at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)

(A)_[owned]_
(B)_[occupied]_

by you from falling, or being washed or carried, on to the street or into any sewer or gully in it in such quantities as to obstruct the street or choke the sewer or gully, failed to comply with that notice within 28 days of the service of the notice on you
english.legislation: Contrary to section 151(3) of the Highways Act 1980.

english.notes:
(i) Proceedings for this offence shall not without the written consent of the Attorney General, be taken by any person other than the person aggrieved, or a highway authority or council having an interest in the enforcement of the provision or byelaws in question - section 312 Highways Act 1980.
(ii) The meaning of "highway" is defined in section 328 Highways Act 1980.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale and if the offence is continued after conviction he is guilty of a further offence and to a further fine of £1 for each day on which the offence continues.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
